title: A friend gives strength, a river footing
odia:
ବନ୍ଧୁ ବଳ ଦିଏ
ନଈ ଥଳ ଦିଏ।
literal_meaning: A friend gives strength; a river gives footing.
meaning_odia: ବନ୍ଧୁ ବଳ ଦିଅନ୍ତି, ନଈ ଠିଆ ହେବାକୁ ଥଳ ଦିଏ—ଦୁଇ ପ୍ରକାର ଭରସାକୁ ପଙ୍କ୍ତିଟି ଏକାଠି ରଖିଛି। ପାଣିରେ ପାଦ ରଖିବାର ସ୍ଥାନ ପରି ବନ୍ଧୁଙ୍କ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ମଣିଷକୁ ସ୍ଥିରତା ଓ ସାହସ ଦିଏ ବୋଲି ଆମ ପାଠ। ଏଠାରେ ଥଳର ଅର୍ଥ ପାଣି ଭିତରେ ଠିଆ ହେବାର ସ୍ଥାନ।
explanation: The rhyme brings two kinds of support together. Footing in water gives the body somewhere to stand; a friend’s support gives a person strength. Our editorial reading emphasises the steadiness that help can offer, without specifying whether that help is practical, emotional or material.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A difficult task feels manageable after a friend offers to help. The person receiving that support recalls the friend who gives strength and the river that gives footing.
cultural_context: ବଳ and ଥଳ rhyme, while the repeated ଦିଏ balances the two gifts. The water image makes support tangible: something beneath the feet rather than an abstract assurance.
